messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Rapid queue growth detected on dedicated pool d-prod-resv-3. queue_length=2,012 (+1,532 in 12m). Throttles observed for reserved tenants: GreenfieldPay reported 429s. Autoscaler attempted 6 scale actions; 5 failed with quota/exhaustion. Pager routed to oncall (lina). https://internal.ops/runbooks/gpu-pool
lina: I'm on it. Paging infra/sre and mlops. P1 for now. @matt @raj @eva please ack and share initial hypothesis.
matt: ack. I'm seeing repeated errors from the cloud API: "quotaExceeded: Cannot create instance, account limit reached (max-instances=50)". Autoscaler is retrying but backoff hits limit. Also some nodes are filled with long-running jobs from non-enterprise test tenants. Will pull logs.
raj: ack. Looking at queue histogram: lots of long tail requests from a single tenant id=gf-pay-tenant (GreenfieldPay). Their jobs are ML-large with sequence len spikes causing slow per-token throughput -> holding GPUs longer. Might be noisy neighbor combined with overall pool saturation.
eva: also seeing high memory fragmentation on some GPUs; a few models couldn't fit and got routed to larger instance types which we don't have capacity for. Suggest immediate mitigation: route GreenfieldPay to a smaller quantized model (gpt-8q) temporarily, and apply tenant-priority throttling so reserved requests get precedence.
sam (cs): I'm already on a call with GreenfieldPay support and they report elevated latency and 429s in the past 10-15m. They're asking for ETA. I'll coordinate customer comms once we have mitigation.
deploy-bot: scale request submitted: scale d-prod-resv-3 to +8 nodes. Result: FAILED. Error: "AccountLimitExceeded: Could not allocate 8 nodes (limit 50 reached)".
matt: trying quick wins: 1) identify long-running non-critical jobs to preempt 2) evict dev reservations 3) apply tenant throttle. I'll run eviction script now.
matt: running: ```
# list running jobs on d-prod-resv-3
./infra/bin/list_jobs --pool d-prod-resv-3 --output json | jq '.[] | {job_id, tenant, runtime_minutes}'
```
matt: Found ~42 jobs > 90m from tenant "dev-internal" and ~6 from "benchmarks". Marking those for immediate preemption.
raj: Before evicting, we should set a controlled eviction policy to avoid mass retries. Using preempt=true + grace=30s.
matt: executing eviction: ```
./infra/bin/evict_jobs --pool d-prod-resv-3 --filter tenant:dev-internal,benchmarks --preempt --grace 30
``` 
matt: eviction issued. Also temporarily lowered non-enterprise concurrency: ```
# runtime API
curl -s -X POST https://runtime.api.internal/v1/policies/priority -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"pool":"d-prod-resv-3","default_priority":10,"overrides":{"tenant:gf-pay":100}}'
```
eva: routed GreenfieldPay to quantized variant with runtime flag: ```
# fallback routing
curl -X POST https://runtime.api.internal/v1/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"gf-pay","from_model":"gpt-xxl","to_model":"gpt-xxl-8q","duration_minutes":60}'
```
eva: also applied short-circuit caching for common prompts for gf-pay which should reduce token generation by ~15%.
sam (cs): FYI GreenfieldPay says they can tolerate short degraded quality for 30-60m if it stabilizes.
raj: running health checks: queue_length dropped from 2012 -> 1,150 after evictions and routing (5m). Throttles still present but reduced. Autoscaler still blocked by account limit.
matt: can we temporarily reassign some reserved capacity from lower-priority reserved pools? There's a pool d-staging-resv-1 with 8 reserved GPUs lightly used.
alex (pm): we have policy constraints on moving reserved capacity across customer contracts. Legal/commerce needs sign-off. Not immediate. Don't reassign enterprise reservations without approval.
lina: understood. For immediate fix, keep eviction + throttles + fallback routing. Start escalation to quota owners to request increase. @matt file the quota request and ping cloud-ops.
matt: filed quota increase ticket CLOUD-REQ-4321. Pinged cloud-ops on pager channel. ETA unknown (they usually respond 30-90m).
deploy-bot: autoscaler retry queued. Next attempt in 32s.
matt: adding one more mitigation: enable model-level burst cap to prevent single tenant hogging a GPU for large batches. ```
# add per-request limit
curl -X POST https://runtime.api.internal/v1/models/gpt-xxl/limits -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_tokens_per_request":1024,"max_batch_size":4}'
```
eva: that will reduce head-of-line blocking. Also enabling KV-prefix caching for stable prompts to reduce repeated compute.
raj: update: queue now 620. Error rates for gf-pay down from 23% -> 6%. Good improvement. Still seeing occasional 429s for other reserved tenants.
lina: good progress. Next: 1) formalize mitigation steps in incident timeline 2) oncall handoff in 1h to next SRE (mika) 3) postmortem owner (raj) 4) customer updates via sam. I'll take first coordination.
sam (cs): sent initial update to GreenfieldPay: "We're actively mitigating: applied temporary routing to lower-memory model and tenant prioritization. Expect improvement in next 10-30m. Will follow up with timeline and RCA." They replied :thumbsup:.
raj: note for postmortem: root causes look like 1) lack of aggressive per-tenant rate limiting, 2) autoscaler blocked by account quota, 3) no fast-path eviction for noisy tenants on dedicated pools.
eva: immediate action items I can take now: add a short circuit in runtime to limit outstanding tokens per tenant to 3k, and add a scoring signal for model memory usage so autoscaler prefers packing-friendly variants.
matt: cloud-ops responded on pager: we can get +10 instances but it requires approval from infra-lead (scc) and ~45m to provision. They provisioned 4 as emergency patch. deploy-bot reports 4 nodes added.
deploy-bot: scale result: SUCCESS +4 nodes; pool capacity increased, autoscaler resume normal.
raj: queue dipped to 180 after the node add and evictions. Error rates back to baseline ~0.8% across tenants. GreenfieldPay confirmed degraded but acceptable. Closing immediate on-call alert but keeping incident open for postmortem.
lina: handing off to next oncall (mika) at +1h. mika, bring the context: evictions, quota ticket CLOUD-REQ-4321, routing to 8q, and runbook link: https://internal.ops/runbooks/gpu-pool. Postmortem owner: raj. Please ensure we implement hard tenant rate-limits and quota pipeline.
mika (oncall): ack (will pick up).
alex (pm): please add product impact note: which SLAs might be affected and customer list for outreach (GreenfieldPay primary). Also track cost impact of emergency node add.
sam (cs): will follow up with GF-pay about their tolerance and whether they want credits. Logged incident to CS ticket CS-9876.
lina: immediate incident actions summary (I'll paste to pager and exec channel): 1) Evicted non-critical jobs in pool d-prod-resv-3 2) Applied tenant priority override for gf-pay 3) Routed gf-pay to quantized model 4) Filed quota request CLOUD-REQ-4321 and got emergency +4 nodes 5) Queue stabilized and errors reduced. 6) Next steps: postmortem, permanent tenant-rate-limits, autoscaler retry/backoff improvements, quota monitoring.
raj: postmortem checklist: collect logs from autoscaler (logs link: https://internal.logs/autoscaler/d-prod-resv-3), collect job traces for noisy tenants, create threshold alerts for per-tenant GPU-hogging, and propose policy for reserved pool emergency borrowing.
matt: I'll follow up on a quick patch to autoscaler to avoid tight-coupled retries on quota errors (exponential backoff + alerting). Will PR today.
lina: thanks everyone. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. We'll reconvene for RCA tomorrow 10:00am PST. :white_check_mark:
